```yaml
name: Build Universal macOS DMG

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    tags: [ 'v*' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-dmg:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [x64, arm64]
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        architecture: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pyinstaller
        
    - name: Build for ${{ matrix.arch }}
      run: |
        pyinstaller --onefile --windowed --name SSHPilot main.py
        mv dist/SSHPilot dist/SSHPilot-${{ matrix.arch }}
        
    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: sshpilot-${{ matrix.arch }}
        path: dist/SSHPilot-${{ matrix.arch }}
        
  create-universal:
    needs: build-dmg
    runs-on: macos-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: Download artifacts
      uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
      with:
        pattern: sshpilot-*
        merge-multiple: true
        
    - name: Create universal binary
      run: |
        mkdir -p universal-app
        lipo -create -output universal-app/SSHPilot \
          sshpilot-x64/SSHPilot \
          sshpilot-arm64/SSHPilot
        cp -r sshpilot-x64/* universal-app/
        rm -rf sshpilot-x64 sshpilot-arm64
        
    - name: Setup pandoc
      uses: r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc@v2
      
    - name: Create DMG
      run: |
        # Create DMG structure
        mkdir -p dmg_contents/Applications
        cp -r universal-app/SSHPilot dmg_contents/Applications/
        
        # Create DMG
        hdiutil create -volname "SSHPilot" -srcfolder dmg_contents -ov -format UDZO sshpilot.dmg
        
    - name: Upload DMG
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: sshpilot-universal.dmg
        path: sshpilot.dmg
        
  sign-and-notarize:
    needs: create-universal
    runs-on: macos-latest
    if: github.ref_type == 'tag'
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: Download DMG
      uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: sshpilot-universal.dmg
        path: .
        
    - name: Import Code Signing Certificates
      uses: apple-actions/import-codesign-certs@v2
      with:
        p12-file-base64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTS_P12_BASE64 }}
        p12-password: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTS_PASSWORD }}
        keychain-password: ${{ secrets.MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
        
    - name: Codesign DMG
      run: |
        codesign --force --deep --sign "Developer ID Application: ${{ secrets.MACOS_TEAM_ID }}" sshpilot.dmg
        
    - name: Notarize DMG
      run: |
        xcrun notarytool submit sshpilot.dmg \
          --apple-id "${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}" \
          --password "${{ secrets.APPLE_APP_PASSWORD }}" \
          --team-id "${{ secrets.MACOS_TEAM_ID }}" \
          --wait
        
    - name: Staple Notarization
      run: |
        xcrun stapler staple sshpilot.dmg
        
    - name: Upload Notarized DMG
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: sshpilot-notarized.dmg
        path: sshpilot.dmg
```
